problem: Emergency contacts: the name column is squeezed to about 30px, so 'Naresh Kumar · Father' breaks one or two letters per line (Nar / esh / Ku / mar) beside the phone number, arrow and Remove buttons.
suggested_fix: In the <li> (tabs.tsx about line 262) give the name span a real basis (for example basis-full sm:basis-auto, or min-w-[9rem]) so the phone and buttons wrap to a second line instead of crushing the name.

problem: The 7 status buttons (P A L H E LV M) need about 332px but the card has about 296px, so the last button 'M' (Medical) is cut in half at the card edge on every student row. The page is also 1px wider than the screen. Fine at 390.
suggested_fix: Status buttons use min-w-11 (44px) with gap-1. Below 380px use min-w-0 flex-1 (the row is already w-full when there are many statuses) or min-w-9, or reduce the card's side padding.

problem: The 'Send 8 templates to WhatsApp for approval' button does not wrap and is 339px wide: it sticks out of its card and makes the whole page 16px wider than the phone. The phone then zooms out and the bottom nav sits partly below the screen (labels cut).
suggested_fix: Let the button wrap (whitespace-normal, h-auto, py-2) or use a shorter phone label ('Send 8 for approval'); make it w-full on small screens.

problem: A teacher sees no student on the first screen: date, tabs, info box, progress bar and 4 counter cards (the 4th, LV Leave, wraps to its own row) fill it. The sticky Save bar covers the 'Name or roll no.' search and the 'All present' button.
suggested_fix: On phones, fold the info box once read, show the 4 counters as one compact row of chips, and add bottom padding / scroll-margin so the sticky Save bar never covers the search row.

problem: Counter labels are hard-clipped with no '...': 'Follow-ups due toda', 'Complaints sent as c'.
suggested_fix: Let the label wrap to 2 lines (remove nowrap / overflow-hidden) or use shorter phone labels ('Follow-ups today', 'Complaints').

problem: The marks table shows only Student, Eng, Maths, EVS. Tel, Hin, Total, %, Grade and Rank are off to the right with no sign that the table scrolls sideways, so a first-time user will not find Total or Rank.
suggested_fix: Add a visible scroll hint (edge fade plus 'Swipe for Total and Rank'), keep the Student column sticky, or on phones show one card per student with Total / % / Grade / Rank first.

problem: Tablet filter row: the search box is squeezed to a 70px box with only the icon, and 'All exam dates' overlaps it. The page title wraps to 2 lines with the pin icon on a third line.
suggested_fix: Let the filter row wrap at md (flex-wrap, search min-w-[12rem]); keep the title on one line and put the year picker under it.

problem: Tablet filter row: the 'Search homework' box is squeezed to 'Sear' next to the long date-range pill.
suggested_fix: Give the search min-w-[12rem] and let the row wrap at md, or put the date pill on its own line.

problem: Filter selects cut their own words: 'Any days lat', 'All reminder', 'Any due...'. The 'Send reminder to all 362...' button label is cut. Each row's second line is cut to 'Class 7 B · Tuiti...', so the fee item is lost.
suggested_fix: Stack the filters one per row below 400px, let the reminder button wrap, and show the fee head on its own line in each row.

page: Collect Fee (Discount, waiver, date or note opened)
problem: The 'Paid on' time box is too narrow: '9:30 AM' shows as '9:30 AI'. The Reason placeholder is cut to 'Example: father's'.
suggested_fix: Put date and time on separate rows below 400px, or give the time input min-w-[7.5rem].

problem: English left on a Telugu screen: the subtitle '362 students owe ₹1.04 Cr past the due date · 319 more than 30 days late' and the 4 bucket labels '0 to 30 days', '31 to 60 days', '61 to 90 days', 'Over 90 days'.
suggested_fix: Wrap these strings in t() / Words and add te and hi catalogue entries.

problem: English left on a Telugu screen: 'Class teacher <name>' on every class card, 'Nursery to UKG', 'Bank transfer', 'No payments today yet', 'Payments show here as they come in.'
suggested_fix: Translate these labels (some already have entries in src/lib/i18n/catalogues/en.ts but are not wrapped on this page).

page: Student profile, Collect Fee, Send Message, Results (Telugu)
problem: More English on Telugu screens. Profile: 'None overdue', 'Link existing', 'Edit enrolment', 'Attendance today', 'Not marked yet', 'Fees overdue', the APAAR consent text. Collect Fee: 'Show 1 చెల్లించారు' (half English), 'Due 10-04-2026', 'Roll 1'. Send Message: 'Find and add at least one person.' Results: 'Joined after this exam' and part of the joined-after note.
suggested_fix: Wrap these in Words / t() and add catalogue entries; make 'Show {n} paid' one translatable phrase.

problem: At 768 the phone bottom nav is gone and the left rail shows icons only, with no labels. A touch tablet has no hover tooltip, so a first-time user cannot tell Fees from Finance or Hostel from Transport.
suggested_fix: Show short labels under the rail icons at md (as the phone bottom nav does), or keep the labelled bottom nav up to 1024px.

problem: Hero tile label is cut to 'Fees collected to...'; hostel bars read 'Boys' Ho...' and 'Girls' Ho...'; 'Needs your attention' titles wrap into a narrow column because of two right-hand icons, and the detail line is cut ('Yash Agarwal, Reya...').
suggested_fix: Allow 2-line tile labels; on phones move the hide (eye-off) icon into a menu so titles get the width.

problem: With 4 icons in the top bar, the page title and school name are cut: 'Attendance Regis...', 'Appointme...', 'Homework ...', 'Enquiries &...', 'Sunrise Public S...'.
suggested_fix: On phones move the tasks icon into the More sheet, or let the title use a smaller size / 2 lines.

problem: Placeholders are cut mid-word: 'Name, admission no., parent na' (Students), 'Student name, admission no., ap' (Collect fee), 'Student name, class or nur' (Pickup), header search 'Search a student, parent, staff r'.
suggested_fix: Use shorter phone placeholders ('Name, adm. no. or phone') or move the hint under the box.

problem: Tap targets under 40px: tab-strip scroll arrows 32x32 (every module), Fee Dashboard 'Today / Yesterday' 28px tall, appointment day chips 'Today, Mon 16 / Tue 17 / Wed 18' 28px, Front Office 'Open' links 32x20, appointment time slots about 30px, Day Book switch 44x24, Collect Fee row checkboxes 20x20, dashboard '2 waiting. Open Approvals' 27x25.
suggested_fix: Raise these to at least 40px on touch (pointer: coarse), or enlarge the hit area with an ::after.
file_hint: shared tab strip and segmented control in src/components/ui

problem: Dark mode: the unselected status letters (A L H E LV M) are dim grey on near-black and hard to read.
suggested_fix: Use text-ink2 instead of text-ink3 for unselected status buttons and check 4.5:1.

problem: Monthly collection chart labels (axis numbers and Apr to Mar) are about 8px on a phone; 'Sept Oct Nov' crowd together.
suggested_fix: Use 11px labels on phones and show every other month or one-letter months.

problem: The sheet header is crowded: 'Sound on' and 'Mark all read' each wrap to 2 lines next to the title.
suggested_fix: Use icon buttons with small labels underneath, or move 'Mark all read' to the sheet footer.

problem: Sub-lines are cut where the cut part matters: '16 stude...', 'Class 1 B · 16 stude...', walk-in titles 'Bonafide certificate for p...'.
suggested_fix: Allow 2 lines for these sub-lines, or shorten them ('16 students' to '16').

problem: The top bar says 'Student' while the page title says 'Students'. The 'All classes 361' chip disagrees with the subtitle '363 studying' (2 are not in a class), with no explanation.
suggested_fix: Use the same word in both places, and explain the 2 not in a class next to the chip.
